direction: She looks down the hill at grey cloud rising off the marsh and tells him to call the animals in. The geese are fat this year: one for the turn of the year, and one for his mother, or they will never hear the end of it.

lines.en: Call them in, then. There's cloud coming up off the marsh. And the geese are fat this year: one for the turn of the year, and one for your mother, or we'll never hear the end of it.
